steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Dr. Brand!! You're alive!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Tsk.
Ted aims his gun once again at the man who had managed to survive.
Stop! Ted!|...
His gun is too swift. The bullet shoots into the air. When it is less than half a meter away from Brand, a dark jet of smoke bounces it off.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's Mania. This... is very strong power, on a completely different level.
How strong... Is he a Sinner? No, he isn't. But he's completely different from those Manic gangsters. The dark smoke around him seems to be at his order. More importantly...
The dark smoke around him seemed to be at his order. Something is driving him to action.

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: ...Gray ...Han... And...

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: ...Laura. Don't cry... Laura... No one can hurt you anymore...

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: This can't be... Brand... Are you also...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Wh——!!! Stop him! Don't let him get close!

steps.speaker: Ted's Men
steps.content: Ha! Haha! Kill him! kill him!!! I'll do it! Let me do it!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you guys out of your mind?! Don't go! He...

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: ... Aaahhhh... Aaahhhh—!!!
It happens like a flash. Like an ear-piercing roar, black spikes shoot out of Brand's body, then immediately twist and blend with his flesh.
The next second, his body is like being half-reshaped by his uncontrolled fury and turns into a real monster.

steps.speaker: Ted's Men
steps.content: Aaahhhhh——————!!

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Dr. Brand—!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wh-what is this? Is this... really the guy from earlier?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Not anymore. It's a Corruptor now, a stronger Corruptor.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, protect the Chief.

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: Let those who hurt you guys... go... to... HELL!!!
